test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A person has to cover a distance of 8 km in 1 hour. If he covers one-fourth of the distance in one-third of the total time, what should his speed (in km/h) be to cover the remaining distance in the remaining time so that the person reaches the destination exactly on time?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance to be covered = 8 km

Total time = 1 hour

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculation:**

Distance covered in one-third of total time = One-fourth of total distance = (1/4) × 8 = 2 km
